A homemade device for finding stashes.
The signal pulses faster as the target gets closer.
 
%c[255,238,153,26]Stash detection:
%c[255,0,223,48]Green:%c[255,180,180,180] 20 m
%c[255,0,166,223]Blue:%c[255,180,180,180] 10 m
%c[default]Does not detect other stash tiers.

%c[255,238,153,26]Stash detection:

%c[255,238,153,26]Special lead:

Does not detect red or green stashes.
